title: The Response, the receipt rules and errors
source: spec/socket-draft-00.md (doc rev 39), spec/ERRATA.md, spec/DECISIONS.md, registry/generated/registry.json, reference/python/bnap_ref.py
header: Responses are signed by the receipt key SHA-256("bnap test receipt key") (draft-00 8.1).
ClientReceiptCheck applies 9.3 "on a receipt" and binds the receipt to the request the
client sent: its Digest, its OfferID and, where the offer allows, the charge.

Valid.description: A well-formed input every implementation must accept.

Structure.description: A required record missing or a bad value.

Ack.description: The ack does not verify: a record changed after signing.

Key.description: The receipt key is not pinned for use receipt at settled_at.

Clock.description: settled_at more than 60 s from the client's clock, without replayed.

Binding.description: The receipt answers another request or charges something else.

Replayed.description: A replayed receipt keeps the original settled_at.
